lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed vapaaree giaan raas karamee palai hoi ||
lines.translation: The Vedas are only merchants; spiritual wisdom is the capital; by His Grace, it is received.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਸੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲਦਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raasee baaharaa lad na chaliaa koi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without capital, no one has ever departed with profit. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)m birakh bahu sa(n)cheeai a(n)mrit ras paaiaa ||
lines.translation: You can water a bitter neem tree with ambrosial nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: biseear ma(n)tr visaaheeai bahu doodh peeaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You can feed a venomous snake lots of milk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਭਿੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਪਥਰੁ ਨਾਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh abhi(n)n na bhijaee pathar naavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is resistant; he cannot be softened. You might as well water a stone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh mahi a(n)mrit si(n)cheeai bikh kaa phal paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Irrigating a poisonous plant with ambrosial nectar, only poisonous fruit is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sa(n)gat mel har sabh bikh lahi jaaiaa ||16||
lines.translation: O Lord, please unite Nanak with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, so that he may be rid of all poison. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਿ ਨ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਪੁਛੀ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran na moorat puchhiaa puchhee thit na vaar ||
lines.translation: Death does not ask the time; it does not ask the date or the day of the week.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਇਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਨੑੀ ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanhee ladiaa ik lad chale ikanhee badhe bhaar ||
lines.translation: Some have packed up, and some who have packed up have gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanhaa hoee saakhatee ikanhaa hoee saar ||
lines.translation: Some are severely punished, and some are taken care of.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਸਣੈ ਦਮਾਮਿਆ ਛੁਟੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: lasakar sanai damaamiaa chhute ba(n)k duaar ||
lines.translation: They must leave their armies and drums, and their beautiful mansions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਢੇਰੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਈ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dheree chhaar kee bhee phir hoee chhaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the pile of dust is once again reduced to dust. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਢੇਰੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੰਦਾ ਕੋਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dheree dhahi paee mitee sa(n)daa kot ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the pile shall fall apart; the fortress of the body is made of dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ਖੋਟੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਖੋਟੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bheetar chor bahaaliaa khot ve jeeaa khot ||2||
lines.translation: The thief has settled within you; O soul, your life is false. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਨਕ ਵਢੇ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin a(n)dar ni(n)daa dusat hai nak vadhe nak vadhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are filled with vicious slander, shall have their noses cut, and be shamed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਰੂਪ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa karoop dukheee sadaa kaale muh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: They are totally ugly, and always in pain. Their faces are blackened by Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalake uth nit par darab hirahi har naam churaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They rise early in the morning, to cheat and steal from others; they hide from the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu tin kee sa(n)gat mat karahu rakh lehu har raaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, let me not even associate with them; save me from them, O my Sovereign Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paiai kirat kamaavade manamukh dukh paaiaa ||17||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs act according to their past deeds, producing nothing but pain. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh koee hai khasam kaa khasamahu sabh ko hoi ||
lines.translation: Everyone belongs to our Lord and Master. Everyone came from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa taa sach paavai koi ||
lines.translation: Only by realizing the Hukam of His Command, is Truth obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaneeai buraa na deesai koi ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh realizes his own self; no one appears evil to him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaaeeai sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Fruitful is his coming into the world. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa daataa aap hai aape melanahaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Giver of all; He unites all with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad mile na vichhuRahi jinaa seviaa har daataar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are united with the Word of the Shabad; serving the Lord, the Great Giver, they shall never be separated from Him again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hiradai saa(n)t hai naau ugav aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Peace and tranquility fill the heart of the Gurmukh; the Name wells up within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap teerath sa(n)jam kare mere prabh bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Chanting and meditation, penance and self-discipline, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage - the merits of these come by pleasing my God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradaa sudh har sevade sohahi gun gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: So serve the Lord with a pure heart; singing His Glorious Praises, you shall be embellished and exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere har jeeu evai bhaavadaa guramukh taraaiaa ||
lines.translation: My Dear Lord is pleased by this; he carries the Gurmukh across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh melian har dar sohaaiaa ||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is merged with the Lord; he is embellished in His Court. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੀ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanava(n)taa iv hee kahai avaree dhan kau jaau ||
lines.translation: Thus speaks the wealthy man: I should go and get more wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak niradhan tit din jit din visarai naau ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak becomes poor on that day when he forgets the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੜੈ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਘਟੈ ਆਰਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj chaRai vijog sabhasai ghatai aarajaa ||
lines.translation: The sun rises and sets, and the lives of all run out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਾਰੈ ਕੋ ਜਿਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man rataa bhog koee haarai ko jinai ||
lines.translation: The mind and body experience pleasures; one loses, and another wins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਰਿਆ ਫੂਕਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਥੰਮੑੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko bhariaa phook aakhan kahan na tha(n)mheeai ||
lines.translation: Everyone is puffed up with pride; even after they are spoken to, they do not stop.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਫੂਕ ਕਢਾਏ ਢਹਿ ਪਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vekhai aap phook kadhaae dhahi pavai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; when He takes the air out of the balloon, the body falls. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat naam nidhaan hai jithahu har paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Name is in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. There, the Lord is found.
